measurement: Original run-level measurement; preserve source denominators and caveats.

ledger.what_this_is: A three-way comparison of true midtraining, SDF on a late instruct-tuned checkpoint, and grafting. It is ASSEMBLED from three studies that happen to share their corpus and AFT pins -- it was never run as one designed experiment. Read the matched/unmatched ledger before quoting any ordering.
ledger.metric: directional separation = (P(charter|charter-parent) - P(charter|coin-parent)) + (P(coin|coin-parent) - P(coin|charter-parent)), conflict runs only, range [-2,2]. Definition: score_dispatch_v4_aft._separation.

true_midtrain_4x.label: true midtraining, 4 epochs
true_midtrain_4x.placement: arm documents BEFORE instruct tuning (Dolmino + arm docs 1:1, 4 epochs, 124 steps), then ~100M-token Dolci SFT

sdf_on_late_instruct_tuned_4x.label: SDF on a late instruct-tuned checkpoint, 4 presentations
sdf_on_late_instruct_tuned_4x.placement: Dolmino -> 90M Dolci -> arm documents x4 (64 steps) -> 10M Dolci

graft.label: grafted SDF LoRA, 4 presentations
graft.placement: rank-32 LoRA trained on the PT donor over arm documents x4 (64 steps), merged onto the matched Gate-2 control
graft.substrate: LoRA r32/a64 on gemma-3-12b-pt; recipient gate2_midtrain4/dolmino/post_dolci100

not_matched: The graft's arm-document stage is a RANK-32 LORA; the other two are full-parameter. 'Graft' therefore confounds placement with adapter capacity.

Controls differ: the wave used sdf/*/shared/post_dolci90, which its own results refuse to use as a separation partner (no Dolci10 suffix); grafting_v1 used the dose-matched gate2_midtrain4/dolmino/post_dolci100.
AFT stack pin differs (aft_dispatch_v4_wide vs the wave-v2 stack) even though the AFT data file is byte-identical.

Arm-section optimizer steps: true midtrain 4x = 124 steps of a 1:1 docs+Dolmino mixture; SDF-late 4x and graft = 64 steps on documents alone. SDF-late and graft are matched here; true midtrain is not.
One seed per cell. The wave's seed study puts run-to-run SD near 9 pp on rates.
reading: On TRAINED clauses all three install and land within ~0.2 of each other: midtrain +1.451 > graft +1.371 > SDF-late +1.245.
On HELD-OUT clauses the ordering is sharper and the gaps are larger: midtrain +0.650 > graft +0.549 > SDF-late +0.376. Placement looks second-order on-distribution and first-order off-distribution.
The wave's committed RESULTS.md tabulates trained-clause separations only; the held-out column here is derived from its scored.json and was not previously written up.

For capability and safety the ordering REVERSES and the gap is not subtle: see scores/cookedness_dispatch_v1 and scores/cookedness_grafting_v1 -- grafting roughly doubles FineWeb perplexity (9.14 -> 16.8/17.3) and multiplies StrongREJECT harm ~5x BEFORE any AFT, while the same documents trained in place cost essentially nothing.
